headline: Indian Markets Surge As Banking Rally Resumes
bias_text: Indian equity benchmarks logged strong gains in the last session, with the Sensex rising 1.24% to 74,151.04 and the Nifty 50 climbing 1.05% to 22,936.75. The advance was driven by buying in banking and Adani group stocks, pushing Bank Nifty up 1.18% to 54,909.65. ADANIPORTS led the Nifty gainers with a 6.29% surge, whereas HEROMOTOCO declined 4.09%. However, mixed signals from global peers and shifting commodity prices present an evolving market setup.

vix.text: India VIX dropped by 6.95% to settle at 15.12, indicating reduced market volatility expectation. Meanwhile, the USD/INR currency rate edged down 0.02% to 95.19.

asia.head: Mixed Trends In Asian Trading
asia.text: Asian markets showed mixed performance as South Korea's Kospi dropped 5.55% and Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 2.54%, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng rose 1.51%. In the US, tech sector weakness dragged the Nasdaq down 1.38% due to AI spending concerns. Meanwhile, European markets registered gains, led by Germany's DAX rising 1.31%.
